prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: source design reference for tiny modular pixel-art game sprites. Subject: P226 style sturdy squared metal service pistol, slightly larger than a polymer G17, external hammer and curved trigger guard. Three configurations: factory; compact with thin grip panel, small muzzle compensator and tiny side laser (no beam); precision with threaded barrel and suppressor, micro red-dot on a low mount and side device. One transparent reference plate, three side-on orthographic right-facing gun configurations, one per row, isolated with generous separation. Restrained desaturated steel grey and warm wood, chunky sharp integer pixel edges, dark single-pixel outline, highlights from top left. No hands, text, letters, numerals, engraving, logos, watermark, shadows, floor, glow, muzzle effects or background. Maintain perfectly horizontal bore. This is design reference only; production H/I/W/Q sprites will be independently drawn on tiny native integer grids. The gun identity must be evident in silhouette.
